Status.note: Status is unchanged. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 7984, generator 001, 60.5 MW, operating since December 2002, with no planned retirement. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale announced.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: A state air permit staff report from July 2024 (https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/-7062929243981508004) says the facility has one Pratt and Whitney FT-8 Twin Pac turbine set of two combustion turbines with a 55 MW nominal rating.

units.notes: The unit is still operating. Latest Activity is left blank because GEM only fills it for units in development or shelved.

qa.recommendation: The Pratt and Whitney FT8 is an aeroderivative turbine. GEM shows gas turbine. Consider changing the technology to aeroderivative gas turbine.
qa.note: The state air permit staff report from July 2024 (https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/-7062929243981508004) names the FT-8 Twin Pac. Calling it aeroderivative is my reading of the model, and the document does not use that word.
